text_block_list.text: One day, I spotted some horse girls talking excitedly in the hallway of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Did you see that?! The look on their faces was so serious! I wonder what they were talking about~~!
Curious, I peeked out the window. Though they were too far to hear, I saw two horse girls speaking with dead serious expressions.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: It has to be some advanced race strategy! Maruzen-san always shares such amazing race knowledge with us, after all!
choice_data_list: (Incredible. I need to work hard and not fall behind, either!)
(Incredible. I need to work hard and not fall behind, either!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Understood. Then I won't hold back at all either, here I come.

text_block_list.name: Maruzen & C.B.
text_block_list.text: Rock, paper—

text_block_list.name: Maruzen & C.B.
text_block_list.text: Scissors!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: No way, you're kidding?! And here I was totally sure I'd win~~!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, a promise is a promise. I'll leave representing the academy at tonight's party to you, alright?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ugh~~ I'm really no good at being put on a pedestal~. It just makes my shoulders all stiff.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: *sigh* How should I kill time until the party?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! I know!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Heeey~. Why not take a break and chat with me for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: We could talk about trendy hotspots~, or popular sweets~. It might give you some fresh inspiration, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aww, no no, I'm sorry! I won't get in your way, so just let me hang around!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come on, I just want to spend some time with you, Ramonu-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmm~, that's really impressive. To think you can grow them so splendidly!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Right?! ...Wait, isn't it boring just watching?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: If you want, jump in and do it with me. I'll lend you some tools!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh~~, I wonder if that's a good idea~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I even let the houseplants in my room wither, so I'm pretty sure I just don't have a green thumb.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Then what did you come here for?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious? Because I wanted to chat with you, Ace-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Being all by myself gets lonely, so I wanted some attention!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: What's with you, acting so needy all of a sudden? When in front of the underclassmen, you always play the dependable senior.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's completely different. I can't let those girls see this side of me, right? That I'm—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Hold up, Maruzen.
(*Rustle rustle—*)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So this is where the two of you were.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I received some fine tea leaves, you see. How about taking a break for some leisurely relaxation—a tea break?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, it was just you. I got tense for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What is the matter? Was my timing poor, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Nah. Just means we can enjoy our tea without any worries.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Exactly♪ Let's relax and have some grown-up talk♪
One day, I spotted Maruzensky and the others heading toward the cafeteria.
I figured they were probably having a serious discussion again, just like last time.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... I can't even manage this much... I really am... hopeless...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Oh dear.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Haaai! What's the matter, cutie? Are you having some troubl-ing situation?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Maruzen-senpai?! U-Um... I'm troubled over my training menu...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Is that so? If you'd like, I'm happy to give you some advice, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So with that, Ace-chan, I'll be going now. ...Let's continue our talk later♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Got it. Make sure you go be a great senior!
One day, I spotted Maruzensky giving advice to her juniors on the training course.
Seeing her constantly relied upon never failed to impress me.
